reduced versus Q2 retained-hero control surfaces
findings: Original side photography clipped the lid and the underside was underlit. Independent inspection-r01 cameras use evaluated mesh bounds and a camera fill; all complete-object views now retain an 8 percent margin.
The reduced export visibly faceted rings and control caps. Q2 preserves evaluated hero geometry, UVs and normals, with an explicit 150k-triangle closeup budget. Reduced exports remain for comparison.

The full opening has a slow initial lift and a restrained settle. Boot glyph/progress gives way to ready content. The subtle button travel is easier to inspect in the runtime closeup than the fixed whole-device video.
remaining: The board camera/header, panel seams, control shapes and side-rail proportions are still approximate.
The concept boards disagree about hinge axes. This candidate uses one transverse hinge and a protective side rail.
The screen is a replaceable placeholder. No concept UI image is baked onto geometry.
Tangent-generation warnings remain (31 for v2; 38 for v3). Runtime renderers supply the microfinish tangent basis.
The 15-angle lid/base surface test is not a complete manufacturing certification or exhaustive check of all static solid pairs.
Only the main button has a dedicated feedback clip; other controls remain separate reusable geometry/pivots where authored.
